node.title: Re^2: Using a git filter to Cache HTML Resources Locally
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
How do you do this without filters?

I'm not quite sure what you're asking specifically... you can edit the files manually, you can used a hacked solution like [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/blob/gh-pages/_misc/import_regex_tester.pl|this], or you can use a different script like [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/blob/e12f1aa25a/cache.pl|this] (the now removed predecessor of htmlrescache). [id://1223860|This] is how you would use htmlrescache standalone.
